author: reek
body: path-combine and path-filename were bound as builtins with no emitter, and the whole time both already existed for real: path-filename is written in Foreword chapter Path, and path-combine is path-join wearing a name nothing implemented.

author: reek
body: The bindings were not merely dead. They were harmful. A program that never cited Path still type-checked, because the type environment vouched for the name, and then died at emit with a diagnostic about an unresolved function offset. Removing them means the same program now fails at name resolution, which is where it should have failed, and a program that does cite Path gets the function that was always there.
